description.text: 1.Self-support students should pass the master entrance examinations. 2.Scholarship students will be enrolled according to the relevant regulations after being approved by Office of foreign students and the specific school or department they apply to.

duration.text: The Human Kinesiology and Science at Beijing Sport University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency. 9. Photocopy of valid passport(liaoning) 1. The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2. Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 10.Master's thesis
